summary.text: Kamilah Bywaters is the Democratic candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Drew Teitelbaum (R).
An educator and Las Vegas native, she has worked as a special education teacher.

paragraphs.text: Kamilah Bywaters was born in Las Vegas and earned a high school diploma from Rancho High School, a bachelor's degree from Howard University in 2006, a graduate degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2008, and a graduate degree from the Howard University School of Divinity in 2014.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has served as a licensed K-12 special education teacher in the Clark County School District, the District of Columbia Public Schools and local charter schools, and is pursuing a Ph.D. in Special Education.
She said she is co-chair of the Las Vegas Alliance of Black School Educators and has held leadership roles with the National Action Network and the National Association of Equal Justice in America.
Bywaters ran for the Clark County School District Board of Trustees, District E, in 2024, when Lorena Biassotti defeated her.
She advanced from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary for Assembly District 2.
In the survey, she listed affordable housing, strong public education, good-paying jobs, small business growth and affordable healthcare among her priorities.
